aim:
The Dart Setup Builder: three radio questions (experience, release, grip) that on submit
compute a barrel weight range, tungsten percentage, shaft length range and flight shape,
each with a one-line reason. Pure client-side arithmetic over fixed bands -- no fetch, no
randomness. 1 active placement, canonical component, no forks.
contract: - Root `div.tool-container`, heading `Dart Setup Builder`, three `fieldset.db-fieldset`
question groups inside `#db-form`.
- **The results panel is the discriminator.** `#db-results` is server-rendered carrying
`db-hidden` (`display:none`) and all four `.db-value` spans ship EMPTY -- verified in the
served HTML, not inferred. So every `computed_values` assertion below is unsatisfiable by
any static render: `Text()` is `InnerText()` (`run_checks_action.go:1288`), which reads
`""` on a hidden element. This is the batch-7 interactive rule met by construction.
- **The arithmetic is pinned at two vectors, and the second one exercises a branch the
first cannot.** Defaults (beginner/smooth/pinch) must give `18g to 21g`; driving
advanced+firm+back-weighted must give `21g to 26g` -- the firm branch subtracts 1 and
clamps through `Math.max(15, low-1)` / `Math.max(low+1, high-1)`, so a rewrite that drops
the clamp moves the second figure while leaving the first standing.
- **Check ORDER is load-bearing** (one shared page, declaration order). `results-start-hidden`
must precede the first submit; `submitting-reveals-the-results` and
`every-output-carries-its-reason` deliberately CONTINUE from the state the default-vector
check left, which is also what a visitor does. Do not make them self-contained.
- Gestures click the `<label for=...>`, never the radio: the inputs are `opacity:0` 1x1
hidden controls, and the label is both the real visitor gesture and the actionable target.
- **`selector_count` is NOT used and must not be reintroduced** -- it is `selector_exists`
under a second name and discards `expect_count` in silence (LANDMINES, 2026-08-10). The
three-questions claim is carried by `interaction` on the THIRD fieldset's legend instead.
proof_note: Single active placement (canonical row, no forks); page 200, 25,867 B with a DOCTYPE; page name `tool-setup-builder` equals the function, so the Tier-4 lookup `name IN (function,'tool-'||function)` resolves -- checked explicitly, because 9 of batch 8's 17 do not.
mutants: 11 mutants, 12/12 checks watched red, baseline green, every `from` verified to occur exactly once in the served page
notes: - **The goldens were DERIVED and then CORROBORATED, not blind-captured.** `computed_values`'
own doc comment warns that a golden captured from an already-wrong tool pins the wrong
answer. `toolgolden.py` could not capture here anyway -- it drives numeric controls and
clicks the first button carrying an `onclick`, and this tool is radio-driven with an
`addEventListener` submit. So both vectors were computed by hand from the component's own
JS bands (`weightBase`, `tungstenInfo`, `releaseShaft`, `gripFlight`) and only then run
against the live tool, where they matched exactly on the first trial. Two independent
derivations agreeing is a stronger warrant than a capture, which can only ever say "this
- **A `pages.rebuild_policy='generic'` subject was chosen deliberately for the first tool of
the batch.** A failing acceptance verdict inserts an `improve_tool` work item with
`handler_agent='tool-improver'` (RUNBOOK 11); firing that at another lane's `owned` page
hands their tool to an automated rewriter. robot-hands' two clean singles are both
`owned` and want a word with that lane first.
